maturityModel.note: Maturity is an engineering status, not a performance guarantee.

capabilities.name: Airdrop+ advisory lane
capabilities.purpose: Advisory scan with optional model providers

capabilities.name: Evolution auditor
capabilities.purpose: Bounded gap detection and upgrade proposals

upgradeQueue.reason: Model-assisted verification is optional and must never be mistaken for live multi-model operation.
upgradeQueue.action: Expose provider availability in every run report; keep deterministic fallback active.

upgradeQueue.reason: Configured feeds are not the whole internet.
upgradeQueue.action: Record uncovered categories, failed domains, stale feeds and candidate source suggestions; quarantine new sources until verified.

upgradeQueue.reason: A flat row is weaker than claim-level provenance.
upgradeQueue.action: Preserve claim, source, retrieval time, hash and conflict relationships.

upgradeQueue.reason: Sudden zero-result or volume spikes can indicate upstream failure.
upgradeQueue.action: Compare current counts with recent history and mark anomalies instead of silently accepting them.

upgradeQueue.reason: Maximum reward alone can waste owner time.
upgradeQueue.action: Model estimated effort, requirements, fees, deadline pressure and reversibility separately.

upgradeQueue.reason: Opportunity surfaces are expanding beyond classic airdrops.
upgradeQueue.action: Add AI safety, open-source, research, security, grants, hackathons and creator/maintainer programs as separate lanes.

selfModificationPolicyDescription: Generated plans never rewrite production code or trust policy.
nextCycle: Observe -> detect gap -> propose -> test -> review -> deploy -> measure -> rollback if degraded
